title: An entry in the queue
description: One repository to scan. Every entry has this shape, however it got here: a repository someone adds (repos/<owner>/<repo>/repo.json, one file each) and a repository from the list of everything on GitHub with 100 or more stars (seed/<first character of the owner>.jsonl, one entry per line, sorted by repo). check.ts holds both to it.

url.description: The repository on GitHub, as GitHub spells it.

stars.description: Its stars when it was added; null if they were not looked up.

addedBy.description: The GitHub account that added it: the author of the commit that adds the entry. A GitHub App's login ends in [bot].

via.description: How it got here: the Add box on the site, a pull request written by hand, or the list of repositories with 100 or more stars.

commit.description: The commit to scan, when it is pinned. Without one, the scan pins the head of the default branch and records it.

schema.description: Deprecated: the first entries carry it. New ones leave it out.
